item.title: How to prevent brute force attacks in Node.js
item.description:
Brute force attacks attempt to gain unauthorized access by systematically trying all possible password combinations. As the creator of CoreUI, I’ve implemented brute force protection strategies that successfully blocked millions of attack attempts while maintaining seamless user experience for legitimate users in enterprise applications.

The most effective approach combines rate limiting, account lockout, and CAPTCHA challenges.
